# Raid EN06 Guardian Solo: 10 Sec Pro Guide

![Raid EN06 Guardian Solo: 10 Sec Pro Guide](/uploads/660_blog-teaser-template.jpg)

![skywalka](/public/avatar_skywalka_fo76_nuka_knights_variant2_square_white-black.png) 

In this article we will describe a build and method to defeat the EN-06 Guardian alone in the 1st stage of the RAID. This method requires fully equipped legendary perks and also appropriate 4 star mods for the best result and is therefore suitable for **advanced players** (approx. from level 500). There are 2 variants in this guide: **Human** and **Ghoul**. Both are possible.

| ![](/uploads/collab-nukaknights-angryturtle-150px.png) | This article was created in collaboration with **Angry Turtle [Youtube]**. Fallout 76 Pro Guide - Human & Ghoul - 10s! Raid Guardian EN06 Solo Q2 2026 | 

##Content

## Requirements

- from level 50-60 (when all required legendary perks are leveled up to the maximum)
- Enclave plasma rifle with flamethrower mod and scope
- Agressotron head
- Legendary Mods:
 - 1x Raging or [Human]1x Bloodstained
 - 1x quick
 - 1x quick
 - 1x precise
 - 1x quadruple
 - 1x cripple
 - 1x Polished
 - Armor: Human
 - 5x Unyielding
 - 5x Intelligence 2*
 - 4x The Rangers
 - 1x cross border
 - Armor: Ghoul
 - 5x chameleon
 - 5x agility
 - 5x The Rangers

## Perk Cards (Human)

**Legendary Perks**

In this example we use **Legendary Strength** 4*, **Legendary Perception** 4*, **Legendary Intelligence** 4*, **Legendary Agility** 4* and **Legendary Luck** 4* Other combinations are also possible, you just have to adapt the selection of your SPECIALs accordingly.

In addition, **Aftermath** 4* is used here to improve the damage of sneak attacks.

**Strength [10] +5 legendary STR**

| Easy target 3* | *75% more damage against crippled enemies* | 
| Bullet hail 3* | *9% damage per 30 units of ammunition consumed. Max. 10 stacks. That's a 90% bonus after 300 shots. 180% when 20 stacks are full.* | 
| Loading 2* | *You keep half of your bullet stacks when reloading. +1% reload speed per stack. This way you can reach the limit of 20 more quickly. In this case only as a backup, since we don't normally need reloading.* | 
| Shotgun Champ 3* | *+10% damage against crippled targets per projectile your weapon fires.* | 
| Travel first aid kit 2* | *Chems (including Stimpaks) weigh 90% less. Alternatively: Thru-Hiker Mod on the 3* of the armor.* | 
| Weapon carrier 2* | *Your weapons weigh 75% less.* | 

**Perception [10] +5 Legendary PER**

| Number Eater 3* |  *2% more damage per AP cost point. That's +28% on the Plasma Rifle, +60% on the Aggressotron Head.* | 
| Tormentor 2* | +20% damage for each crippled body part of your target. Since the shield is crippled here, we get a 20% bonus. | 
| Tank Killer 2* |  *Your ranged weapons ignore 40% armor.* | 
| Smart Shooter 3* | *Deal +25% damage to weak points when aiming a scoped weapon.* | 
| Middleman 3* | *You deal +75% ranged damage when targeting the torso.* | 
| Cover on 2* | *+10% damage for each attack your target has. Here it is +10% from crippling the shield.* | 

**Stamina [3]**

| Thru Hiker 2* | *Food and drinks weigh 90% less. Alternatively: Thru-Hiker Mod on the 3* of the armor.* | 
| Strengthened genes 1* | *Ensures we keep our mutations even when we use Rad Away.* |
